findings.status: Existing historical conditional finding independently reconnected to bounded current 95e source; no new count or automatic alias.
findings.observation: The wall resolver derives a local clear height capped by resolved wall height less sill and clearance. The rectangular profile keeps the original opening height while sectional void and physical closure use the capped value. Timber vertical-span logic can reduce that wall height by the joist zone and, on upper levels, floor-surface offset. Current source reads corroborate the same conditional relation recorded in F046, not a separate new failure.
findings.conditions_and_limits: Only when clipping is active can the retained profile and physical subtraction/closure heights disagree. No supported normal recipe exhibiting that condition, accepted final plan, complete audit branch, bar consumer behavior, failure or runtime symptom is established by this packet. The saved 774 finding reports broader historical source and audit windows; these do not transfer to our current reading.
findings.future_repair_direction: At the actual accepted wall/opening boundary decide a single resolved aperture authority for profile, sectional void and physical closure, or reject incompatible geometry with the appropriate existing error; preserve distinct inner/exterior heights and curved shapes. No implementation performed.

nonfindings_and_open_questions.assessment: The gate called by generate_structure requires the exact fixed URBAN_BRICK_BASILICA and footprint 28 by 14 when a programme is present; its four nave bays yield a nonempty nave axis before this indexed consumer. nonfindings_and_open_questions.topic: Timber height relation and material selection
nonfindings_and_open_questions.assessment: For InternalTimber the method shifts base 0.08 m on non-ground levels and subtracts that and 0.50 m from wall height; other materials preserve base and height. Raw low heights can make the arithmetic remainder nonpositive, but permitted inputs, particular wall/opening path and all checked geometry recipients were not fully traced. No supported accepted invalid wall, saturation demand or independent finding is established.
